failure.title: Authoritative coverage exposed repository and changed-code behavior gaps
failure.note: The retained machine coverage summary records repository branches at 77.39%, changed lines at 86.87%, changed branches at 75.21%, and changed functions at 83.70% after 685 Vitest tests and the Node-native regression passed.
failure.diagnosis: Owned presentation, client-runtime, adapter, and edge-state behavior had executable branches without direct assertions. The critical backend domain/application scopes were already complete, but aggregate repository and changed-code gates correctly rejected the uncovered behavior.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
